elaine_cs: Heads up — StratusHealth says the enterprise credit Jordan promised on their PO never landed. They attached a PO with a note 'Apply Q3_PROMO, contact sales'. Billing shows zero manual adjustments. Can we triage?
jordan_sales: I added the PO note and sent a manual credit approval email last week. I also cc'd finance. customer says their automated billing flow tried to apply a promo and errored with auth issues.
maria_finance: I don't see any pending adjustment for StratusHealth in the ledger. Do we have the PO attachment or the approval thread from legal/sales? I need PO# and invoice/date to create manual ledger entry.
elaine_cs: PO#: SH-7321, invoice 2026-07-11, sales quote reference S-9982. Attached screenshot from customer shows the PO note exactly: "Apply Q3_PROMO, contact sales". They also pasted an error from their integration: \`403: unauthorized - api key invalid for billing.apply_credit\`.
jordan_sales: Hmm — I used the internal promo code name Q3_PROMO when I approved; maybe the billing pipeline expects the full code string Q3-REDWOOD-2026. I did not attach the actual promo code string to the PO, just the human note. My bad.
sam_backend: Quick context: our credit-apply job matches promo codes against PO notes using strict tokenization (exact token match). If the PO text doesn't include the promo token we store the PO metadata but do not auto-apply. Also the 403 the customer saw means their service account key lacks billing.apply scope — separate but happened during their retry attempt. Repro steps for the matching problem: 1) curl GET /internal/po/SH-7321 -> returns note field "Apply Q3_PROMO, contact sales" 2) run python script that tokenizes notes: `tokens = re.findall(r"[A-Z0-9-_]{4,}", note)` -> yields ["Apply", "Q3_PROMO", "contact", "sales"] 3) promo lookup `promo_lookup('Q3_PROMO')` returns null because canonical promos are stored as `Q3-REDWOOD-2026`.
maria_finance: Ok — give me the canonical promo id and the approval email and I can create a manual ledger adjustment. Also need the signed PO PDF for audit.
jordan_sales: Canonical promo is `Q3-REDWOOD-2026` and approval email is from me to finance on 2026-07-09 (subject: StratusHealth Q3 promo approval). I will re-send the thread and attach the signed PO.
elaine_cs: Customer also reported auth error when trying to call our billing API during retry. They used a service key from their app integration. Sam, is that likely due to missing billing scope on their API key?
sam_backend: Yes — billing endpoints require the billing:apply scope for service keys. We saw a spike of these 403s yesterday from several customers who attempted automated apply. Suggestations: (a) update docs to call out scope requirement, (b) surface a clearer 403 message linking to docs, (c) add a defensive error in the UI when a key lacks scope.
billing-bot: Ticket #CS-5821 created for StratusHealth credit apply + auth failures. Assignee: maria_finance. SLA: 3 business days.
maria_finance: I made the manual ledger adjustment: LAID=LA-2026-789, amount=$45,000, applied to invoice 2026-07-11. I uploaded the adjustment and linked it to PO SH-7321 in the finance portal. Please confirm with customer. I also attached the adjustment memo for audit.
elaine_cs: Confirmed with StratusHealth — they see the credit applied. They still need guidance to avoid the 403. Jordan, can you include the service-key scope note in the follow-up email?
jordan_sales: On it. Drafting note now: include exact promo code `Q3-REDWOOD-2026`, require billing:apply scope for service keys, and attach PO PDF + finance memo. Will send to customer and upload audit copy to the contract. :white_check_mark:
maria_finance: Closing CS-5821 after upload of PO and adjustment memo. Leaving a follow-up task to work with eng to loosen promo tokenization to allow common aliases.
sam_backend: I'll raise a small ops PR to accept common aliases (e.g., Q3_PROMO -> Q3-REDWOOD-2026) and add a diagnostic log when auto-apply fails. Will link PR to the ticket.
elaine_cs: Thanks everyone. Outcome: manual credit applied (LA-2026-789), docs + warning about billing scope, engineering change to improve PO note matching. :tada:
